'''Clan Flashblade''' was one of the districts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phemiss]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. It bordered six other districts, and was the home of [[Clan Flashblade]], with which the district shared its name. Like the rest of the city, the district's homes were [[Adobe/Legends|adobe]] and were grouped together in circular blocks. The district also contained [[Fort Plympto]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Flashblade was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
